similarity_threshold.compared_to: similarity_score of the deduplicated BIBLIOGRAPHY results of all planned bibliography actions; the gate fires when EVERY result is < 0.4 (i.e. the best one is < 0.4), only when the graph returned nothing
similarity_threshold.what_that_score_is: search_bibliography.search_hybrid (l.335-511): weighted reciprocal-rank fusion, score = 61 * sum_legs(weight_leg / (60 + rank_leg)), so a document ranked 1st by both legs scores 1.0 and the top document of one leg alone scores that leg's weight. 'bibliography_semantic' actions also go through search_hybrid (weights 100/0), so their top result always scores 1.0. Raw cosine is only recorded in retrieval_details.
similarity_threshold.consequence: the gate is rank-based and independent of the cosine scale: with both legs returning hits the best score is >= max(semantic, keyword weight) >= 0.5, so it can only fire when the keyword leg returns no hit at all and the semantic weight is < 40 % (or the semantic leg fails and the keyword weight is < 40 %). Switching the embedder does not move it. The fallback branch tests the RAW planner keyword_weight ((a.keyword_weight or 50) > 60) while the legs use normalize_weights(), so a plan such as semantic_weight=30 with keyword_weight unset (effective 30/70) takes the 10/90 KEYWORD fallback; if that also finds no lexical hit it scores 0.1 and NO_RELEVANT_SOURCES is set with a working embedder. The router in the 2026-09-15..10-07 traffic always set keyword_weight=70 explicitly (semantic fallback, score 1.0), so this is latent; it is embedder-independent either way.
similarity_threshold.author_results: search_by_author results score (_score/2 = (cos+1)/2), i.e. cosine-scaled, and are only added when graph evidence exists, which disables the gate. But deduplicate_bibliography_results() sorts them TOGETHER with the RRF-scored hybrid results and build_bibliography_source_context() keeps the first 8, so the cosine scale does decide the author-page / hybrid-page mix whenever a plan combines graph_scholar with bibliography actions (not seen in the 2026-09-15..10-07 traffic: graph_scholar plans were alone)

primary_hybrid.formula: function_score(match_all or filters; score_mode sum, boost_mode multiply): semantic_weight * (cosine + 1) + keyword_weight * 1[fuzzy multi_match hit]; the keyword function has no script, so it adds a constant per matching document (not BM25)
primary_hybrid.callers: the /search/hybrid endpoint (Advanced Search slider, default 50/50). The chat agent's primary_hybrid action builds SearchRequest(semantic_weight=..., keyword_weight=...), whose model has no weight fields, so search_hybrid's request.semanticWeight raises and the action fails (logged as 'Search failed')
primary_hybrid.consequence: a document without a lexical hit outranks one with a hit only if its cosine is higher by more than keyword_weight / semantic_weight; at 50/50 that needs a cosine gap > 1

production_usage.primary_semantic: search_service.search returns similarity_score = raw cosine (script_score cos + 1, minus 1); the frontend shows it as '% match' (SearchResults.jsx, DocumentModel.jsx); no threshold. search_bibliography.search (l.224-280) likewise returns raw cosine; ChatUI.jsx only prints the bibliography similarity_score
production_usage.shared_embedder: one embedding service (src/embedding_service, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B @ 97b0c614) serves query vectors for BOTH the fragment index (ELASTICSEARCH_INDEX) and the bibliography index (ELASTICSEARCH_BIBLIOGRAPHY_INDEX); app.py verify_embedding_compatibility checks the canary in BOTH indexes' mapping _meta at startup and disables all semantic search if either fails

recommendation_2026_10_07.similarity_threshold: Keep SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.4 for v9 (verified). It gates the normalised weighted-RRF score of bibliography search_hybrid (61 * sum w/(60+rank)), which depends on ranks only, so the embedder swap cannot move it. With the router's 30/70 plans any keyword hit down to rank 46 already scores >= 0.4, so the gate fires only when the keyword leg is empty (1.5 % of 1,109 bibliography test queries, all one-word ones such as 'Brakhot', 'sugarcane', vocalised Hebrew); it then swaps in a 100/0 semantic top 5 (score 1.0) and never yields NO_RELEVANT_SOURCES in observed traffic. Absence is detected by the lexical subject-presence gate.
recommendation_2026_10_07.raw_cosine: No raw-cosine gate exists. If one is ever added, do NOT reuse 0.4 or the fragment-pool 0.55-0.58: on the bibliography index the tuned model lowers cosines by ~0.1 (all query-page pairs mean 0.235 -> 0.109, p95 0.41 -> 0.27; known-item top-1 median 0.601 -> 0.486; random page pairs median 0.459 -> 0.325); raw 0.4 sits at p93.9 of all pairs under base and p99.4 under tuned. Calibrate per model and per index on chat-like unanswerable questions (v9_ood_queries.json).
recommendation_2026_10_07.author_merge: search_by_author's (cos+1)/2 is the one cosine-scaled score that competes with RRF scores (sorted together, top 8 kept). Tuned lowers the best author page from 0.795 to 0.738 (median). Simulated graph_scholar + one 30/70 action: author pages in the top 8 fall from 3.17 to 2.80 on average while the target page reaches the top 8 more often (0.68 -> 0.74). No observed plan combines the two, so no change is needed for v9; if they are combined later, rank-fuse author results instead of mixing scales.
recommendation_2026_10_07.hybrid_weights: Bibliography (RRF): no change. Primary /search/hybrid: sw*(cos+1) + kw*1[lexical hit]; at the 50/50 default and down to 70/30 a lexical hit outranks any non-hit under either model (would need a > 3x spread change; on the bibliography index the tuned top1-top10 spread is only 1.23x the base one, 0.053 -> 0.066). Only 90/10 and 80/20 move; rule kw'/sw' = kw/sw * spread_tuned/spread_base once the fragment pool is embedded.
recommendation_2026_10_07.v9_switch: Yes: build v9 document vectors with the tuned model at index time (semantic text, raw, no prefix, fp32, max_seq 8192, normalised); queries with exactly 'Instruct: Given a search query, retrieve relevant passages\nQuery: ' passed as prompt= (embedding_models.py already does this; the tuned repo's prompts['query'] is the stock web-search text and must not be used). Switch via EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME / EMBEDDING_MODEL_REVISION (compose env; also update the defaults in embedding_models.py); the container needs an HF token for the private repo or a pre-filled hf_home; do not set fix_mistral_regex. Re-embed the bibliography index with the tuned model in the same deploy and write new _meta canaries for both indexes: the base-vs-tuned canary cosine is 0.41, so a base-vector bibliography index fails the startup canary and disables ALL semantic search (bib_v9_check.py: re-embedding the bibliography is safe, gains on Hebrew and subject queries).
